label: mega-audit sprint: sitewide truth drift, Desk slug-rerun class, micro-feedback transmits
topWin: The Desk's 3-day duplicate was a class defect (every dedupe layer compared AI-rewritten text, never the deterministic identity) and is now structurally unshippable at three layers, locked by a gate proven-fail on the live defect.
topGap: The feedback loop is wired but starving — Cloudflare Web Analytics does not observe the production hostname, so every voluntary-signal floor waits on one founder dashboard toggle.
ignisNote: A session that audits everything must still land in phases — the three-agent sweep plus a founder-locked decision set turned an unbounded 'improve everything' mission into 8 sequenced phases, and the discipline that mattered most was proving each new gate fails on its live defect before trusting it.
